; Test fixture zone. Both builds load this in tests.
nas.home.lan.     300 IN A     192.168.1.10
nas.home.lan.     300 IN AAAA  fd00::10
files.home.lan.   300 IN CNAME nas.home.lan.
printer.home.lan. 300 IN A     192.168.1.20

; Tab-separated fields and a TTL of its own.
tabs.home.lan.	60	IN	A	192.168.1.30
; CNAME whose target is not in the local zone.
ext.home.lan.     300 IN CNAME www.example.org.
